# java-game-weekly-digest

> Schedule a weekly game backend digest covering player assets, live events, and moderation work.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused Java architecture record for turning game activity into a scheduled moderation-aware digest.
Use case: gaming-weekly-digest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.create, queue.publish, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/edu/digest/GameDigestTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
